lede: The biggest item this week is a proposed town ordinance — reviewed by the Ecology Commission on December 2 — that would phase out gas-powered lawn and garden equipment in Telluride, starting with leaf blowers in 2028 and covering mowers, trimmers, and the rest by 2030. The Housing Authority Subcommittee meets the same day to decide whether to grant a deed-restricted homeowner a $160,000 capital improvement exception for a roof replacement — the kind of decision that sets precedent for how the program works in practice. The County Commissioners also hold a special session December 3 to work through 2027 budget adjustments, including wildfire mitigation funding and a Chamber seed-money request.

notable.stake: Proposed ordinance would ban gas lawn equipment townwide by 2030.
Board decides if deed-restricted owner can exceed capital improvement limits.
Public hearing on expanded street closure for 2027 Skijoring event.
County votes on 2027 budget adjustments including wildfire mitigation funds.
